projects.name: Moss Landing battery storage expansion
projects.quote: We also made significant progress on other projects, including an additional 350 MW of battery storage at our Moss Landing facility, which is expected to come online in mid-2023.

projects.name: Moss Landing battery energy storage system
projects.quote: The company owns and operates the 400-MW/1,600-MWhbattery energy storage system in Moss Landing, California, the largest of its kind in the world.

projects.name: Comanche Peak
projects.quote: Vistra has 3,408 MW of zero-emission generation and energy storage online (including our 2,400 MW nuclear facility, Comanche Peak), with additional renewable generation and energy storage developments in the near-term pipeline.

projects.name: Comanche Peak license extension
projects.quote: Recently, Comanche Peak applied to extend its licenses through 2050 and 2053 for the two-unit facility, an additional 20 years beyond the original licenses.

projects.name: Texas zero-carbon generation and storage
projects.quote: 2022, Vistra brought online 418 MW of zero-carbongeneration and storage in Texas, while also retiring approximately 2,900 MW of fossil generation in Ohio and Illinois.
